subject: Supplier enrollment playbook & next onboarding checkpoints
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier enrollment playbook & next onboarding checkpoints

Hi Elena — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed immediate next steps so procurement can get us into your Ariba/Coupa instance and we can start test traffic by early July.

Call highlights:
- Decision maker: Procurement (you) will own portal activation and banking verification.
- Technical owner: Marissa will own test integration with your staging endpoint.
- Required docs: vendor form, W-9, banking details (ACH), insurance cert (if required).

Proposed onboarding checklist (short version):
1) Vendor portal preference & invite (Ariba or Coupa) — owner: Orion Procurement — due: 2025-06-20
2) Completed vendor enrollment form (PDF) — owner: Orion — due: 2025-06-23
3) W-9 & banking details — owner: Orion — due: 2025-06-23
4) Redwood supplies vendor profile & test credentials — owner: Redwood (SoG/Marissa) — due: 2025-06-25
5) Test call & token exchange (staging) — owner: Marissa — due: 2025-06-30
6) Legal review & PO/contract signature — owner: Orion Legal / Redwood Legal — due: 2025-07-07

Target close for onboarding: 2025-07-10 (production enabled). Dependencies: internal legal review, completion of vendor portal onboarding, and receipt of W-9/banking info.

Attachments: I’m attaching a short MAP-style playbook with milestones and owners (SO-Map-Orion-8741.pdf). Please confirm whether Orion prefers Ariba or Coupa and if procurement can initiate the vendor invite to vendor-ops@redwood.com.

If helpful I can put a 30-min procurement kick-off on the calendar Thursday (6/19) or Friday (6/20) to walk through the enrollment steps.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Sojin Lee
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0136
[Attachment: SO-Map-Orion-8741.pdf]

From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@orionhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@orionhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier enrollment playbook & next onboarding checkpoints

Thanks Soojin — appreciate the clear summary. Procurement heading (procurement@orionhealth.com) is looped and will own the portal steps. A few quick notes from our side: 

- We prefer Ariba for vendor onboarding.
- I attached our standard vendor request (Orion_Vendor_Form.pdf) — please fill the highlighted fields and return.
- For W-9 and banking, we need legal company name, EIN, bank routing + account, and remit-to address. We can accept a Docusign’ed W-9.

Procurement asked that the vendor contact be vendor-ops@redwood.com (or an individual vendor email) to send the Ariba invite. Also please include your Redwood legal contact for the PO.

I’m available for the kick-off on 6/19 11:00–11:30 PT if that works; otherwise 6/20 in the morning is fine.

Best,
Elena
Director, Strategic Sourcing — Orion Health Systems
[Attachment: Orion_Vendor_Form.pdf]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@orionhealth.com>, Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Supplier enrollment playbook & next onboarding checkpoints — MAP draft + asks

Thanks — Ariba confirmed. Per your request I’ve completed the vendor form where we had the details and left the banking/W-9 fields blank for you to complete (sensitive info). Attached is a short MAP draft with explicit owners, deliverables, and dependencies. Key items below (pulled from the attached PDF so we have them inline):

MAP draft — onboarding milestone summary
- Milestone A: Portal invite sent & vendor record created
  - Owner: Orion Procurement (procurement@orionhealth.com)
  - Due: 2025-06-20
  - Dependency: vendor contact (vendor-ops@redwood.com) to accept invite

- Milestone B: Completed vendor enrollment (form submitted + W-9)
  - Owner: Orion
  - Due: 2025-06-23
  - Dependency: Redwood to provide vendor profile (done) and test contact

- Milestone C: Staging integration & smoke test (token exchange, sample calls)
  - Owner: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.com)
  - Due: 2025-06-30
  - Dependency: Portal provisioning, API credentials from Redwood

- Milestone D: Contract/PO execution and production enablement
  - Owner: Orion Legal + Redwood Legal
  - Target: 2025-07-10
  - Dependencies: Legal redline turnaround, finalized SOW line items

Action items for Procurement team (quick):
- Send Ariba invite to vendor-ops@redwood.com and include Redwood legal (legal@redwood.com).
- Confirm whether Orion requires additional insurance documents (we can provide COI).
- When you have the vendor ID in Ariba please share it here (we’ll add it to our MAP).

I’ve penciled in the kick-off for Thu 2025-06-19 11:00 PT—invitation sent to procurement. If that time does not work, suggest alternate slots and we’ll adapt.

Attachments: SO-Map-Orion-8741.pdf (MAP draft), partially completed Orion_Vendor_Form.pdf.

—
Sojin Lee
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SO-Map-Orion-8741.pdf][Attachment: PartiallyCompleted_Orion_Vendor_Form.pdf]

From: Procurement Team <procurement@orionhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jun 2025 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier enrollment playbook & next onboarding checkpoints — Ariba invite sent

Hi all — quick procurement update after internal ops review: 

- We sent the Ariba invite to vendor-ops@redwood.com this morning; vendor should receive onboarding email within 24 hours. Please confirm acceptance so we can assign your vendor ID.
- Attached is our procurement checklist noting required fields; we still need: Redwood legal name (full), EIN, and a point of contact for invoicing (name + email).
- W-9: we can accept a signed PDF via Docusign — please send or let us know if Redwood prefers to upload through Ariba.
- Tentative onboarding completion moved to 2025-07-09 (we accelerated a few internal steps). Please confirm that production enablement by 2025-07-09 still works for Redwood.

Next steps (procurement):
1) Redwood confirms vendor invite acceptance and provides missing legal/EIN/invoicing contact.
2) Procurement assigns vendor ID in Ariba and shares ID in this thread.
3) Once vendor ID present and W-9 received, procurement will trigger PO creation.

Thanks —
Orion Procurement Team
procurement@orionhealth.com
[Attachment: Orion_Procurement_Checklist.pdf]
